messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — I kicked off a gated rollout for the `kv_prefetch_and_batching` FF. Starting at 10% across EU + US regions, canary size 3k reqs/min. Please monitor latency and error-rate, and ping if you see regressions. plan: https://confluence/release/kv-prefetch-rollout :rocket:
laura: Thanks Sam. Which endpoints are in-scope? embeddings vs text-gen? :eyes:
mike: In-scope: text-gen v2, chat-stream, and the internal reranker endpoint. embeddings are excluded for this rollout.
ara: TL;DR on guardrails? what triggers rollback automatically?
sam: Guardrails: if p95 increases >40% over baseline for >3m OR error-rate >0.75% for >5m we rollback. Also we have a manual cooldown of 15m after toggles. Baseline stored in Grafana dashboard (kv-prefetch/baseline).
mike: Prom query I used to validate: `sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="runtime",route=~"/v2/(chat|generate).*"}[5m])) by (le)`. For p95: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(...)) )` — tweak route filters per model.
laura: Are we collecting decode token latency separately? need to ensure batching doesn't hide per-token spikes.
sam: Yes — `redwood_infer_decode_latency_seconds` is tagged by model and batch_size. Watch `decode_latency_seconds{batch_size!="1"}` too.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag `kv_prefetch_and_batching` set to 10% (canary) by sam at 2026-03-04T14:15:00Z.
ara: Quick perf checks I'm planning: 1) run the replay job against canary subset (replay-tool --audience canary --qps 100), 2) compare p50/p95 vs baseline, 3) run a KV cache hit-rate sweep query. Anyone object?
mike: Sounds good. Add the following quick smoke script to CI to validate decode latency:```
# smoke.sh
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood/v2/generate | jq .
```
laura: I'll watch autoscaler signals — batching can change CPU trends. If we see sustained CPU > 70% for the dedicated pools, raise the ticket in #eng-infra.
sam: Noted — autoscale policy for this rollout set to conservative (scale-up threshold 75%, cooldown 10m).
ara: I'm running a short synthetic flood across the canary now (start 14:24 UTC). Will post p95 snapshot in ~5m.
mike: FYI if you need to query by model use: `sum(rate(redwood_requests_total{model="mistral-7b",flag_kv_prefetch="on"}[2m]))`. That filters only canary-impacted traffic.
ara: p95 snapshot: baseline p95=210ms, canary p95=220ms (5m window) — noise-level. error-rate 0.12% (below guardrail). posting grafana panel: https://grafana/g/kv-prefetch/p95-compare :+1:
sam: Excellent. Hold on scaling until we have 30m stable window. Next step at 30m mark is to bump to 25% if stable.
laura: One note — reranker showed a tiny tail spike on one host (host-23). I SSH'd and saw an older driver on that node. I'm patching now and will drain after patch.
mike: Good catch — add host-level exclusion for canary until it's patched: `--exclude-host host-23` in the rollout audience config.
ara: 30m snapshot: p95=215ms, error-rate 0.14%. No autoscale chatter. Recommend bump to 25%.
sam: I bumped config to 25% (manual). ops-bot, can you confirm toggle?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag `kv_prefetch_and_batching` updated to 25% by sam at 2026-03-04T14:55:10Z.
laura: After bump, I'm seeing a small increase in decode CPU on a few hosts — monitoring. If CPU crosses 80% on >3 hosts, we should revert to 10% and open infra ticket.
mike: Also watch `kv_cache_hit_rate` — if it drops unexpectedly we might be evicting useful prefixes. Query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_total[5m]))`.
sam: Agreed. If both p95 > +30% and kv_hit_rate drops >10% we roll back.
ara: 60m stable update: metrics look stable, I'll put a PR to update the canary audience to 50% tomorrow morning (low traffic window). If anyone wants earlier, voice now.
mike: LGTM. I'll follow-up with a small perf regression test to run against the 50% audience once it's live.
laura: Thx all. Filing a short post-rollout note in #eng-release after the 50% bump.
sam: Great work. If anything pops, ping this thread and call oncall.
ara: rolling notes: rollback cmd (manual): `ffctl set kv_prefetch_and_batching 0 --env prod` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime -l rollout=kv-prefetch` — keep handy.
mike: adding a tiny check to the CI: fail if p95 increases >25ms post-bump for fuzz tests. PR coming.
ara: closing loop — current status: 25% canary, stable. Next milestone: 50% tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
sam: thanks — will update the release doc and post the timeline. :white_check_mark:
